d: We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) HR Techno-Functional Consultant with 5–7 years of hands-on experience in implementing, customizing, configuring, and supporting HR and Payroll modules.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of HR business processes, payroll operations, employee lifecycle management, performance appraisal processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions within Dynamics 365 F&O.
q: Understand and configure employee performance management and appraisal processes.
Implement and support performance evaluation cycles, objectives, KPIs, competency assessments, and employee reviews.
Configure appraisal workflows, evaluation criteria, and performance ratings.
Support the integration of performance management processes with broader HR operations.
Conduct business requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis.
Prepare functional documentation, configuration documents, and user guides.
Perform system testing, UAT, and support deployment activities.
Provide end-user training and post-implementation support.
Recommend process improvements and system optimization opportunities.
5–7 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Strong functional knowledge of HR and Payroll modules.
Proven experience in HR module customizations and enhancements.
Good understanding of HR appraisal and performance management processes.
Experience with workflows, configurations, reports, and system integrations.
Understanding of D365 F&O technical architecture, X++, and data entities.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Ability to work directly with HR stakeholders and translate business requirements into system solutions.
Previous experience implementing HR and Payroll solutions in the UAE or GCC.
Knowledge of UAE/GCC payroll requirements and labor regulations.
r: Configure, implement, and support the HR and Payroll modules in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O.
Manage core HR functionalities, including employee management, organizational structures, positions, departments, and personnel administration.
Handle payroll configurations, salary structures, allowances, deductions, benefits, and payroll processing.
Understand and support end-to-end HR and payroll business processes.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications.
Have hands-on experience with HR module customizations and enhancements in Dynamics 365 F&O.
Work on custom fields, forms, workflows, reports, and system extensions.
Coordinate with technical teams on X++, integrations, data entities, and reporting requirements.
Troubleshoot system issues and provide technical and functional support.

d: Experience: Minimum 3–5 years UAE accounting experience

We are looking for an experienced, reliable and proactive Part-Time Accountant to manage the accounting and financial compliance requirements of several UAE-based businesses operating across technology, software and professional services.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands UAE accounting regulations, can work independently and is confident managing everything from bookkeeping and payroll to VAT and Corporate Tax submissions.
q: Proven UAE accounting experience is mandatory.
Strong working knowledge of UAE VAT, Corporate Tax and FTA procedures.
Demonstrable experience preparing and submitting VAT and Corporate Tax returns.
Experience managing accounting for multiple UAE companies, including free zone entities.
Good understanding of UAE payroll, WPS and end-of-service calculations.
Proficiency in accounting software such as Zoho Books, Xero or QuickBooks.
Strong Excel skills and financial reporting capabilities.
Excellent attention to detail, organisation and confidentiality.
Ability to work independently and meet statutory deadlines.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related discipline.
ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent qualification preferred.
Experience working with Dubai free zone companies.
Experience supporting SMEs, technology companies or professional services businesses.
r: Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting across multiple companies.
Maintain accurate financial records, including accounts payable and receivable.
Manage company expenses, receipts, invoices and reimbursements.
Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.
Prepare monthly profit & loss statements, balance sheets and cash flow reports.
Monitor outstanding invoices, payments and company expenditure.
Ensure compliance with UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) regulations.
Prepare, review and submit quarterly VAT returns through the FTA portal.
Prepare and submit UAE Corporate Tax returns within statutory deadlines.
Maintain appropriate tax records and supporting documentation.
Manage tax registration, renewals, amendments and deregistration where required.
Ensure compliance with applicable UAE accounting standards and IFRS requirements.
Monitor tax deadlines and proactively advise management of upcoming obligations.
Manage UAE Wage Protection System (WPS) requirements where applicable.
Calculate employee benefits, leave balances and end-of-service gratuity.
Manage employee expense claims and reimbursements.
Maintain accurate payroll and employee payment records.
Provide monthly financial summaries to company directors.
Assist with budgeting, financial forecasting and cash flow planning.
Coordinate with external auditors and tax advisers when required.
Maintain organised financial records for each legal entity.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and control costs.
x: Opportunity to support several growing UAE businesses.
Long-term engagement for the right candidate.
Direct communication with business owners and senior management.
Competitive compensation based on experience and agreed working hours.

Important: Applicants must have practical, hands-on experience with UAE FTA filings, VAT, Corporate Tax and payroll. We are looking for someone capable of managing these responsibilities independently, rather than a junior bookkeeper requiring supervision.
